coverageNotes: This is an incomplete guide snapshot, not an exhaustive list of every gift or reaction in the game. Missing relationships are unknown, not neutral or disliked.
Seven additional gift names appear in the preference guide but not the item catalog; their sourceIds point to that guide.

The item catalog lists both Candly Crystals and Candy Crystals. Candly Crystals is treated as a probable spelling variant of Candy Crystals and retained as an alias; the spelling has not been verified in-game.
